messages:
sam.h: Heads up — after yesterday's RBAC role rename rollout we see ~1200 SAML authn failures for tenant "horizons" since 03:15 UTC. Failures: AssertionAudienceMismatch and audit events for role-change not linked. Anyone else seeing this?

mira.p: yep seeing it in prod. Logs show 403 from SP because NameID format changed? grabbing assertion sample now

sam.h: sample (redacted):
```
<samlp:Response ...>
  <saml:Assertion>
    <saml:Subject>
      <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">user@horizons.com</saml:NameID>
    </saml:Subject>
    <saml:AttributeStatement>
      <saml:Attribute Name="roles"><saml:AttributeValue>horizon-admin</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>
    </saml:AttributeStatement>
  </saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

leigh: the new role rename script changed `horizon-admin` -> `horizon-adm`. Oops. RBAC mapping expects canonical name. Is this the migration we scheduled? @sam.h

sam.h: yes we rolled patch at 03:00 UTC w/ canary. We expected scim backfill to map old->new but audit events show the backfill failed with KMS unwrap errors: `kms:AccessDenied` for extid->envelope key.

mira.p: I see KMS error in provisioning logs: `Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException (request-id=abc123)` Looks like key policy didn't include the provisioning service principal after rotate.

leigh: Is this service principal the new ones used by deploy job? Check `terraform state` for iam bindings. If it's missing, SCIM backfill can't re-encrypt extid and mapping fails => stale RBAC.

deploy-bot: rollout 2026-03-23T03:00:12Z triggered; terraform apply included kms_key rotation id `key-92c` — documented here: https://redwood/internal/kms/rotations

sam.h: We need temporary mitigation: allow legacy role name mapping on the auth proxy and surface audit link. Quick patch: add fallback mapping `horizon-adm` -> `horizon-admin` at proxy. Can someone open a quick PR?

mira.p: :thumbsup: I'll open PR and add log markers. Also adding alert to detect `kms:AccessDenied` during provisioning.

leigh: I'll fix key policy and add the provisioning service principal. Need approval from sec-ops for cross-account bind.

sam.h: Also triage note: we lost correlation between SAML assertion and our audit trail because assertion ID was redacted before we stored audit event. For incident & compliance we should keep a hash of assertion ID (HMAC with rotate key) not full ID. Filing follow-up with product and compliance.

leigh: creating incident ticket: INC-2026-042. Tagging legal & compliance.

mira.p: status update in 30 mins. PR #451 opened: adds proxy fallback and metric `sso.authn.fallback_used`
